tax.text: Introduced legislation that would raise taxes on high earners to increase Social Security benefits and improve the program’s finances.
tax.quote: The bill would prevent that by phasing out the income tax cap to protect the benefits that retirees have earned.

wages.text: She says workers should receive wages sufficient to live in California and identifies herself as a labor advocate and co-founder of the Labor Caucus.
wages.quote: Workers deserve good wages that help them afford to live here

trade.text: She has opposed tariffs, saying they raise costs and harm domestic manufacturing.
trade.quote: She’s fought to end Trump’s illegal tariffs which raised costs for everyone and harmed domestic manufacturing.

debt.text: Introduced a bill to increase Social Security benefits, improve cost-of-living adjustments and extend the program’s solvency.
debt.quote: Our bill will also fix the cost-of-living formula so benefits actually keep up with what seniors spend.

housing.text: Sánchez introduced legislation to lower construction costs and encourage the construction of more affordable rental housing.
housing.quote: Our bill removes a real barrier to building more housing to give working families a shot at finding a home they can afford.

schools.text: She introduced legislation to place more counselors in underperforming high schools and advocates for additional resources in public schools.
schools.quote: That bill would place more counselors in high schools with graduation rates of 60 percent or lower.

safety.text: She secured federal funding to upgrade a police department’s communications system and funding for law-enforcement training.
safety.quote: $1.04 million for the Montebello Police Department to upgrade its radio communications.

immigration.text: She has opposed expanded ICE funding and supported reforms intended to protect immigrant families from intimidation and abuse.
immigration.quote: Linda has refused to fund ICE’s reign of terror over our communities and fought for serious reform

health.text: She supports restoring Medicaid funding, protecting Affordable Care Act subsidies, and expanding access to health care regardless of income or medical history.
health.quote: Linda is fighting to protect and expand access to quality, affordable health care for every Southern Californian, regardless of their income or medical history.

energy.text: She secured funding for a transit program to replace compressed-natural-gas buses with zero-emission buses.
energy.quote: $850,000 for Foothill Transit’s Zero Emissions Bus Program.

tax.text: Clemmons says he would reduce government spending and taxes while cutting business regulations.
tax.quote: I will work to provide relief to California tax payers by advocating and working toward reducing the wasteful spending in government, reducing taxes, and cutting business killing regulations.

housing.text: Supports lowering barriers that raise housing costs and expanding paths to homeownership.
housing.quote: Lower barriers that increase housing costs and expand practical paths to homeownership for working families.

schools.text: Clemmons supports a school-choice initiative that would let parents choose their children’s educational path.
schools.quote: I am an advocate of the California School Choice voter initiative. This will allow all parents to choose the best path in education for their student

safety.text: Supports law enforcement, first responders, and public-safety policies.
safety.quote: Support law enforcement, first responders, secure borders, and policies focused on public safety.

immigration.text: Clemmons supports securing the border while creating legal status for qualifying immigrants and making deportation easier for people who commit crimes.
immigration.quote: We should have a secure border, while at the same time we need to couple that with immigration reform.
